organization: ISSOL, the International Society for the Study of the Origin of Life
public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and public conference information
why_relevant: longest-established international society in the field; public contact and meetings are opt-in routes to people who work directly on where life began
notes: contact page lists role-based institutional addresses for organisational enquiries; use one-to-one only, never bulk send

organization: Discover Life (Springer Nature, formerly Origins of Life and Evolution of Biospheres)
field: prebiotic chemistry, early Earth environments, origin of life settings
why_relevant: direct peer-reviewed venue for arguments about origin-of-life settings; formerly the field's longest-established specialist journal
notes: article processing charge applies; confirm current scope and fee on the journal site before submitting

organization: Frontiers in Astronomy and Space Sciences, Astrobiology section
why_relevant: published Westall et al. 2023 'Setting the geological scene for the origin of life'; a ground-visible venue for the setting question
notes: open access with publication fees; check current author guidelines

field: origin of life, prebiotic chemistry, hydrothermal systems
why_relevant: published Omran and Pasek 2020 on different hydrothermal environments and the 2021 review of experimental tests of the alkaline vent model; relevant to the vents-versus-ponds comparison
notes: instructions-for-authors page returned 403 on this run; verify the live submission route on the journal site

field: astrobiology, origin of life, life detection
public_contact_or_submission: public contact page and Ask An Astrobiologist opt-in Q&A channel
